story.paragraph: A muscular man with a red mohawk steps out of a pink van parked on a snowy road. Two people, a man with black hair and an orange scarf and a woman with blonde hair in an orange dress, stand on the road watching him. The man with black hair looks back at him with a serious expression, then smiles briefly before looking serious again. The man from the van smiles slightly in response, then looks away with a serious expression. Finally, the man and woman stand together looking forward.
story.summary: A man with a red mohawk exits a pink van on a snowy road to face a man and a woman standing nearby.
